data.narrative:
Itera is a Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by AJ Cooper (PhD EE, former Uber Jump/Lyft hardware lead), Mattis Fjällström (ex-Verkala), and Alex Withrow (ex-Bridgewater/VMware). The Chips & Semiconductors sector includes 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers spanning Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, SambaNova Systems, PsiQuantum, and Etched, though no same-stage public or private peers with sufficient data exist for direct matching.

Stage-progression analysis provides the primary valuation anchor. Using Itera's $12M total raised as a base and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $30M. Peer-median triangulation is not applicable due to insufficient narrow-filter matches within the Seed cohort—only 0 same-stage and 1 adjacent-stage comparable exist, falling short of the 3-datapoint minimum. Public-comp anchoring via the Semiconductors sector median P/S of 21.5x cannot be applied in the absence of Itera's revenue disclosure, standard for private companies at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M to $34M, centered at $30M. This range reflects confidence in the Stage-Progression method while acknowledging material uncertainty around revenue trajectory, IP defensibility, and competitive positioning within the fragmented frontier-chip landscape. The founder pedigree (hardware operations, distributed systems, investment infrastructure) is noted but not quantified.
